scenarios.scenario: Select the 3D Model tab with its key tip

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the user presses Alt
key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls
the 3D Model tab displays the key tip "M"
the user presses "M"
the 3D Model ribbon tab is selected
key tips appear on its commands
the user presses Escape
the command key tips remain visible
the user presses Alt
the key tips disappear
the part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Open a command using a two-letter key tip

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon command key tips are displayed
the Hole command has the key tip "HO"
the user presses "H"
the visible command key tips are narrowed to matching H-prefixed entries
the user presses "O"
the Hole properties panel opens
the ribbon key tips disappear
the user cancels the Hole command
the properties panel closes without creating a hole

scenarios.scenario: Change ribbon display using key tips and menu navigation

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software

the user reopens the display policy menu with Alt and "X3"

the user presses "O"
